description: Utility functions and constants for color picking, including color name retrieval, hotkey bindings, color usage analysis, contrast calculation, and color darkness detection in the Excalidraw project.

methods.name: getColorNameAndShadeFromColor
methods.description: Retrieves the color name and shade index from a palette given a color string.

methods.name: isCustomColor
methods.description: Determines if a color is custom (not in the palette).

methods.name: getMostUsedCustomColors
methods.description: Returns the most frequently used custom colors in elements based on background or stroke.

methods.name: isColorDark
methods.description: Determines if a color is dark based on YIQ contrast, handling various color formats.
